symptom: goal_backlog_status.json kept reporting stale starved/replenishment_failed states even after ToyOS tasks were active because record_goal_backlog_result merged the previous plan snapshot instead of re-reading tasks.json.
impact: control alerts stayed enabled after successful replenishment
goal_health lagged behind live task state
brain_loop could keep writing stale failure semantics after the queue had recovered
fix: recompute live ToyOS active/pending counts from tasks.json inside record_goal_backlog_result before persisting
store live_goal_counts and live_goal_health alongside the plan snapshot
treat any goal with active tasks as degraded rather than starved unless active_count is zero
validation: goal_backlog_status.json moved from starved to degraded with live active tasks present
control_alert_required cleared after the live refresh
